senses.gloss: (b. h. שָׂטָה; v. נָטָה)to deviate, to turn to or from.
units: Koh. R. to I, 16 הלב סוֹטֶה the heart deviates (turns to evil).—Esp. (of woman) to be faithless.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 2:5:3">Y. Sot. II, 18ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:5:13">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᵈ</cite> <he>אמן שלא סָטִיתִי ארוסה וכ׳</he> ‘Amen’, that I have not been faithless as a betrothed, as a married woman &c.—V. <cite ref="O00286"><he>סוֹטָה</he></cite>.
